title: Transcendence degree in a tower of fields
statement: Let $K\subseteq L\subseteq M$ be a tower of field extensions [def-pc-field-extension]. Transcendence degrees [def-kun-transcendence-degree] satisfy the cardinal equality $\operatorname{trdeg}_K M=\operatorname{trdeg}_K L+\operatorname{trdeg}_L M$ (with cardinal lifts if the fields have different universes). Moreover $\operatorname{trdeg}_L M=0$ if and only if $M/L$ is algebraic, meaning every element of $M$ satisfies a nonzero polynomial over $L$.
